name: cf_dns_sync_standard_cnames
description: Verifica CNAMEs estandar de autamedica.com en Cloudflare (admin, companies, doctors, patients)

steps.description: Validar admin, companies, doctors y patients con sus targets pages.dev

args.script: (async () => { const required = ['admin','autamedica-admin.pages.dev','companies','autamedica-companies.pages.dev','doctors','autamedica-doctors.pages.dev','patients','autamedica-patients.pages.dev']; const start = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - start < 20000) { const t = document.body.innerText.toLowerCase(); const missing = required.filter(x => !t.includes(x)); if (!missing.length) { return 'all standard cnames present'; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('Missing required DNS entries in visible page text'); })()
